poc_summary: POC scope: validate Hosted API for production chat agents with streaming + tool-calling. Workload: multi-tenant SaaS UI with ~30 QPS baseline, 300 concurrent websocket streams at peak. Targets: p50 <50ms, p95 streaming latency <200ms for token arrival; support function-calls with at-most-once semantics. Monitoring: per-tenant usage, stream disconnect rate, token cost per session. Initial findings: stable correctness on single sessions; p95 rises under concurrent connection churn and some timeouts observed during rapid reconnects. Team asking Redwood for tuning suggestions: batching, KV cache, and streaming backpressure controls.
pricing_notes: Discussed two-phase approach: 1) Hosted API POC - usage-based, spike protection; 2) Dedicated reserved pool if p95 latency & streaming stability proven. NovaQuill prefers per-tenant metering + optional committed min for busiest customers. Requested sample pricing sheet (uploaded to drive). AE suggested committed nodes + overage pricing for Dedicated.
